_comment: Google Business reviews. Set placeholder=false and paste the real text, name and date once the Google Business Profile is connected. Any entry left as a placeholder makes the site print a disclaimer under the section.

reviews.name: María R.
reviews.text_en: They took care of me in Spanish from the first phone call, and the report reached my doctor the next day.
reviews.text_es: Me atendieron en español desde la primera llamada y el reporte llegó a mi doctora al día siguiente.

reviews.name: Alina P.
reviews.text_en: I was afraid of the closed scanner. The technologist explained every step and I never felt alone.
reviews.text_es: Tenía miedo del equipo cerrado. El técnico me explicó cada paso y no me sentí sola ni un minuto.

reviews.name: Jorge M.
reviews.text_en: Same-week appointment, no waiting room marathon, and they verified my insurance before I arrived.
reviews.text_es: Cita en la misma semana, sin maratón de sala de espera, y verificaron mi seguro antes de llegar.

reviews.name: Dr. L. Fernández
reviews.text_en: As a referring physician I value that they call me immediately when there is a critical finding.
reviews.text_es: Como médico referente, valoro que me llamen de inmediato cuando hay un hallazgo crítico.
